item.content:encoded:
After a while I’m going to write in my blog. This time in English.

At first because of improving my English writing skills by practicing and have any feedback from others.

Some other reason of writing in my blog is to improve my personal branding and notice everyone who cared about me (or not) to check my Github account.

Recently I’ve started some new repositories and hope to be success to have a good challenge this year:
https://github.com/hmdshariati/helthcare
https://github.com/hmdshariati/import-excel
https://github.com/hmdshariati/my-accounting

I promise to keep update about my activities in this blog and love to have others comments.

item.content:encoded:
Today I’m going to start writing posts in English and win goals decided in the beginning of the year.

At first, I would like to introduce my best teacher that ever I have seen, Parham . He’s full of energy and so conscientious. Every semester, he teach us a lot of idioms and vocabulary every session.

One of helpful advice that I have gained from him is watching animations and summarize it. The first one was Angry Birds. That was so exciting for me that I can’t attend to vocabulary and conversations. I had watched it with my little son, Amir Ali.

I will watch it again to summarize it in other post. Conclusion of this post is that I break the spell and practice English for the first time in home. This is incredible and like as miracle for me.
